sentences.en: The mother extended her hand to her baby, smiling brightly.
sentences.zh: 1. 母亲微笑着向她的婴儿伸出手。

sentences.en: The old woman extended a loving hand to the children.
sentences.zh: 2. 老妇人向孩子们伸出慈爱的手。

sentences.en: This will be another magical evening with our extended family.
sentences.zh: 3. 这将是我们大家庭的又一个神奇夜晚。

senses.zh: 延伸的；扩大的；长期的；广大的
